rows.commentary: 14.2: Shree Charani lands this one on a length outside off, and Modester Mupachikwa steps up to defend it firmly towards the covers.
14.3: Shree Charani floats up a tempting delivery around off, which Modester Mupachikwa meets cleanly and drives down towards mid-off.
14.4: Shree Charani drops it a fraction short on off, prompting Modester Mupachikwa to knock it neatly into the infield ahead of cover.

14.5: Shree Charani strikes as Modester Mupachikwa charges down the track for a lofted drive, mistiming it completely into the air where Kranti Gaud settles underneath it at mid-off to claim the catch.
14.6: Shree Charani spears a quick delivery into leg stump, trapping Sharne Mayers on the pad as she attempts to flick, though the umpire rightly waves away the appeal with the ball sliding down.
15.1: Deepti Sharma loops this one up on off, and Beloved Biza simply pushes it solidly down towards mid-on.
15.2: Deepti Sharma tosses it on off, and Beloved Biza aggressively advances to convert it into a full toss, driving it firmly along the ground to mid-on.
15.3: Deepti Sharma loops it slower on middle and leg, safely nudged by Beloved Biza straight toward mid-wicket.
15.4: Deepti Sharma offers one up on middle, and Beloved Biza dances down the track, absolutely thumping it straight over the bowler's outstretched hand and away to the boundary.
15.5: Deepti Sharma delivers a quicker length ball onto the leg stump, which Beloved Biza whips away swiftly through square leg to pick up a single.
15.6: Deepti Sharma pushes a full and straight delivery onto off stump, and Sharne Mayers dead-bats it smoothly into the covers.
16.1: Shree Charani targets the toes with a full delivery, and Beloved Biza nicely tucks it away through square leg to rotate the strike.
16.2: Shree Charani floats one away from Sharne Mayers, who opens the face to steer it toward point.
16.3: Shree Charani floats it fuller through the air, and Sharne Mayers safely dead-bats it to the off side.
16.4: Sharne Mayers rocks back to carve width through cover, where Mandhana dives sharply to parry it away.
16.5: Shree Charani drifts it onto the pads, allowing Beloved Biza to clip a single through square leg.
16.6: Shree Charani arcs one in, Sharne Mayers slices it into the turf, and they scramble hard for three.
28.4: Sayali Satghare drops it on a good length outside off, and Beloved Biza answers with a sharp back-foot punch straight to cover.
28.5: Sayali Satghare delivers outside off, dabbed away as the runners scramble through amidst a flutter of hesitation, beating the throw home safely on the stretch.
28.6: Sayali Satghare pins a good-length delivery onto off-stump, comfortably defended into the off-side by Chiedza Dhururu.
29.1: Shree Charani floats a loopy offering outside off, safely smothered by Beloved Biza towards short cover.
29.2: Shree Charani lands one on a length around off, dead-bat defended off the back foot into the off-side by Beloved Biza.
29.3: Shree Charani offers width outside off with a short delivery, carved past point by Beloved Biza to collect a single.
29.4: Shree Charani strays down the leg-stump, allowing Chiedza Dhururu to drop low and top-edge a sweep past the unprotected fine leg boundary for four.
29.5: Shree Charani responds with a teasing tossed-up delivery outside off that grips and spins away, completely beating Chiedza Dhururu's outside edge.
29.6: Shree Charani pitches full outside off, crisply driven straight to the mid-off fielder by Chiedza Dhururu.
30.1: Deepti Sharma darts one in, neatly tucked away onto the on-side by Beloved Biza.
30.2: Deepti Sharma fires an off-break onto leg-stump, clipped smoothly off the pads into the on-side for a couple of runs.
30.3: Deepti Sharma loops a flighted delivery right on middle, dead-bat defended straight back to the bowler.
30.4: Deepti Sharma loops it up full outside off, and Beloved Biza calmly steps forward to dead-bat the delivery into the off side.
30.5: Beloved Biza dances down the pitch to drill Deepti Sharma through the covers, forcing a frantic chase and recovery save near the rope after a fielding error.
30.6: Chiedza Dhururu gets right behind the line and presents a straight bat to return the ball firmly back to Deepti Sharma.
31.1: Jintimani Kalita targets middle and leg from a good length, prompting Beloved Biza to push the ball down towards mid-on.
31.2: Jintimani Kalita draws the edge with late away-swing outside off, allowing Beloved Biza to steer a single past the point fielder.
31.3: Wide from Jintimani Kalita to Chiedza Dhururu.
31.3: Dot ball from Jintimani Kalita to Chiedza Dhururu.
44.1: Kranti Gaud strikes as Beloved Biza drills a full, wide delivery straight to Smriti Mandhana at mid-off, giving India two wickets in two balls.
44.2: Kranti Gaud pitches it up on off stump, prompting Olinder Chare to drive the ball toward the right of mid-off for no run.
44.3: Kranti Gaud spears a full ball angling in just outside off, and Olinder Chare simply pushes it back down the pitch.
44.4: Olinder Chare attempts to push down the ground but catches an inside-edge onto her pad off Kranti Gaud.
44.5: Olinder Chare drives toward Smriti at mid-off and scampers across for a sharp single.
44.6: Tendai Makusha tries to flick Kranti Gaud and succeeds only in deflecting an inside-edge into the leg-side.
45.1: Shafali Verma slips a full delivery past the lunging inside-edge of Olinder Chare.
45.2: Olinder Chare steps forward to a full ball on off, dead-batting it cleanly into the off-side off Shafali Verma.
45.3: Shafali Verma tosses it flat on off, allowing Olinder Chare to tap it away to the right of cover.
45.4: Olinder Chare works the ball away neatly off her pads square into the leg-side off Shafali Verma.
45.5: Tendai Makusha opens the face of the bat to guide it toward Deepti at short third.
45.6: Shafali Verma extracts sharp turn past the probing defensive blade of Tendai Makusha.
46.1: Kranti Gaud probes the width outside off with a short delivery, tempting Olinder Chare into a slash that beats the outside edge entirely.
46.2: Kranti Gaud offers a fuller presentation outside off, prompting Olinder Chare to slice a drive sharply to the left of backward point.
46.3: Kranti Gaud lands it on a length outside off, and Olinder Chare drives it firmly into the off-side for no run.
46.4: Olinder Chare does not score off Kranti Gaud.
1.5: Nyasha Gwanzura feeds a juicy full toss that Pratika Rawal seizes, drilling it through wide mid-off to collect her third boundary.
1.6: Nyasha Gwanzura targets a fraction short outside off, allowing Pratika Rawal to punch it briskly through the off-side for a single.
2.1: Nomvelo Sibanda delivers a length ball outside off which Pratika Rawal steers late past short third with pure finesse.
2.2: Nomvelo Sibanda attacks with a yorker length outside off that Pratika Rawal squeezes firmly in front of cover-point.
2.3: Nomvelo Sibanda goes full and keeps a touch low, forcing Pratika Rawal into a watchful defensive stroke.
2.4: Nomvelo Sibanda drifts onto the pads, letting Pratika Rawal clip it away through backward square leg for a couple of runs.
2.5: Nomvelo Sibanda slides one down the leg-side, leaving Pratika Rawal unable to connect with her glance.
2.5: Nomvelo Sibanda pitches up outside off, inviting Pratika Rawal to watch it safely through to the keeper.
2.6: Nomvelo Sibanda bowls a fraction short on middle and leg, dragged toward mid-wicket where the fielder gets a hand to parry it toward mid-on for one.
3.1: Nyasha Gwanzura lands it on a length around middle and leg, solidly knocked straight back down the pitch by Pratika Rawal.
3.2: Nyasha Gwanzura drops it short for Pratika Rawal to pull toward deep mid-wicket, where a brilliant sliding stop to her left saves a certain boundary.
3.3: Nyasha Gwanzura serves a fraction short outside off, dispatched by Smriti Mandhana off the back foot through extra cover for a resounding boundary.
3.4: Nyasha Gwanzura floats one onto the pads, and Smriti Mandhana works it cleanly away through the mid-wicket region for a single.
3.5: Nyasha Gwanzura delivers, and Pratika Rawal nudges it down towards mid-off to scamper across for one.
3.6: Nyasha Gwanzura offers width on the shorter side, allowing Smriti Mandhana to punch it through the covers for a brisk single.
4.1: Michelle Mavunga strays down the leg-side, and Smriti Mandhana easily guides it past the circle all the way to the fine leg boundary for four.
4.2: Michelle Mavunga hits a good length on middle and leg, where Smriti Mandhana exquisitely times a clip past mid-wicket that races away to the ropes.
4.3: Michelle Mavunga serves up a fuller delivery, promptly defended straight toward mid-off by Smriti Mandhana.
4.4: Michelle Mavunga pitches slightly fuller around middle and leg, met firmly by Smriti Mandhana as she pushes it towards mid-on.
4.5: Michelle Mavunga watches as Smriti Mandhana drives firmly into the deep extra cover territory, comfortably collecting a pair of runs.
17.4: Olinder Chare fires it in, and Shafali Verma drills it straight down to long-off for a brisk single.
17.5: Olinder Chare offers width outside off, allowing Pratika Rawal to carve a crisp cut shot out to sweeper cover.
17.6: Shafali Verma dances down the track, gets entirely smothered to the pitch of the ball, and drills her drive straight to the cover fielder.
18.1: Beloved Biza digs in a slower short ball on off-stump, nudged away deftly past the bowler for a quick single.
18.2: Shafali Verma mistimes a punch that skids low, slipping right through the flat-footed bowler's grasp for a fortuitous run.
18.3: Beloved Biza pushes it through, and Pratika Rawal gets right forward to dead-bat the delivery into the pitch.
18.4: Pratika Rawal hops back on her crease with assurance, guiding the ball smoothly away to the cover fielder.
18.5: Beloved Biza tosses up a loopy delivery on middle and leg, cleanly driven down the ground towards long-on.
18.6: Shafali Verma charges down the wicket and whips a fierce pickup shot off her pads to cow corner, safely gathered on the bounce.
19.1: Olinder Chare drops it in short, and Shafali Verma rocks back to punch it firmly towards long-off.
19.2: Olinder Chare attacks the stumps with a tighter line, prompting Pratika Rawal to punch with a straight blade out to sweeper cover.
19.3: Olinder Chare loops one up on middle, and Shafali Verma marches down the track to sweep it cleanly along the turf.
19.4: Olinder Chare fires it in, and Pratika Rawal tucks it neatly into the leg side for no run.
19.5: Olinder Chare loops up a leg-break outside off at 66.9 kph, driven cleanly to long-off for a single by Pratika Rawal.
19.6: Shafali Verma chips it aerially wide of long-on, where the fielder sprints across to the right to restrict them to a brace.
20.1: Beloved Biza darts a short one onto the pads, and Pratika Rawal pulls it away into the on-side for a single.
20.2: Shafali Verma dances down the pitch to Beloved Biza and detonates it straight down the ground, one bounce and over the ropes for four.
20.3: Beloved Biza offers width outside off, allowing Shafali Verma to carve a cut shot straight to backward point.
20.4: Beloved Biza pushes it through, and Shafali Verma collects a single out to deep mid-wicket.
24.4: Beloved Biza loops it full and wide, allowing Pratika Rawal to get underneath and stroke a gorgeous inside-out boundary over cover.
24.5: Beloved Biza delivers on a good length to middle, where Pratika Rawal simply nudges it into the on-side.
24.6: Beloved Biza spears it flatter on middle, and Pratika Rawal dead-bats it straight back to the bowler.
25.1: Olinder Chare loops up a leg-break, and Shafali Verma dances down the pitch to violently launch it straight over long-off for six.
25.2: Olinder Chare offers another full delivery that Shafali Verma charges to hoist over the ropes, bringing up a sensational fifty amidst a standing ovation.
25.3: Olinder Chare keeps it flat on middle, and Shafali Verma defends it softly toward the off-side.
25.4: Olinder Chare darts it in, allowing Shafali Verma to step back and steer a single into the off-side.
25.5: Olinder Chare pushes a delivery through, and Pratika Rawal pings it down toward long-on.
25.6: Olinder Chare floats it full outside off, and Shafali Verma skips down to annihilate an inside-out maximum over cover.
26.1: Tendai Makusha drops it short and wide, enticing Pratika Rawal into a cut that whistles past the outside edge.
26.2: Tendai Makusha lands it full on off, and Pratika Rawal can only bunt it off the cue end toward mid-on.
26.3: Tendai Makusha fires it into the pads, and Pratika Rawal whips it neatly through the gap for a brisk couple of runs.
26.4: Tendai Makusha delivers full at the stumps, and Pratika Rawal drills her drive straight into the hands of the mid-on fielder.
26.5: Tendai Makusha serves it short and wide, drawing a frantic heave from Pratika Rawal that takes a thick outside edge and races past the keeper to the boundary.
26.6: Tendai Makusha pitches up, and Pratika Rawal shovels it wide of long-on to seal a magnificent third ODI century, shedding her helmet amid widespread celebrations.
27.1: Nyasha Gwanzura feeds a full, straight delivery that Shafali Verma violently launches down the ground to decisively seal a comprehensive nine-wicket victory for India.
